title: Coupled walls
purpose: Two piers linked by coupling beams at each floor. Symmetry splits each story shear equally; a pier's axial force equals the sum of the coupling-beam shears above it, which depends on the beams' stiffness and is compared between the programs.

settings.endOffsets: off (ETABS automatic end length offsets disabled, forces reported joint to joint)
settings.shells: Shell-Thin, explicit meshes no larger than 4 ft, identical in both programs
settings.piers: PL left, PR right; openings 3 ft wide, 9 ft tall
